scoped.name: Scoped 1.0
scoped.description: Current replacement-ready scope with explicit native/delegated lanes and M7 strict sign-off.

full.name: Full 1.0
full.description: Strict Haxe 4.3.7 compatibility claim for the declared targets and generators below. This is not an all-target drop-in claim.

targetAndGeneratorScope.inventoryBasis: Haxe 4.3.7 `haxe --help` Target section plus its XML and JSON type-description generators; HashLink is split into its two documented output forms.
targetAndGeneratorScope.publicClaim: Haxe 4.3.7-compatible for the declared Full1 target and generator scope.

surfaces.label: JavaScript output
surfaces.rationale: JavaScript is a core Haxe target and already has a native hxhx backend lane.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until the same candidate passes the strict JavaScript target evidence.

surfaces.label: Lua output
surfaces.rationale: Lua is part of the declared source-target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until Lua programs compile and run through the strict target lane.

surfaces.label: Flash SWF/SWC output
surfaces.rationale: Legacy Flash/AS3 output is intentionally outside the hxhx product scope.
surfaces.userConsequence: Projects that still produce SWF or SWC files must keep using upstream Haxe 4.3.7 or another Flash-capable toolchain.

surfaces.label: Neko bytecode output
surfaces.rationale: Neko remains part of Haxe 4.3.7 tooling and test orchestration.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until the strict Neko target lane passes.

surfaces.label: PHP output
surfaces.rationale: PHP is part of the declared source-target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until PHP programs compile and run through the strict target lane.

surfaces.label: C++ source output
surfaces.rationale: C++/hxcpp is a required first-Full1 compatibility target, not an optional follow-up.
surfaces.userConsequence: Full1 stays blocked until the same candidate passes the complete strict C++ lane.

surfaces.label: Cppia bytecode output
surfaces.rationale: Upstream Haxe 4.3.7 exercises Cppia inside its C++ target lane, so Cppia cannot be silently removed from a passing C++ claim.
surfaces.userConsequence: The C++ target does not count as Full1-complete unless its Cppia compile-and-run checks pass too.

surfaces.label: C# output
surfaces.rationale: C# is part of the declared source-target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until C# evidence passes with its declared .NET/Mono toolchain.

surfaces.label: Java source output
surfaces.rationale: Java source output is part of the declared source-target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until Java source output compiles and runs in the strict target lane.

surfaces.label: Direct JVM bytecode output
surfaces.rationale: Direct JVM bytecode is a separate upstream generator from Java source output and has no declared Full1 evidence lane yet.
surfaces.userConsequence: Projects that require `--jvm` must keep using upstream Haxe 4.3.7; accepting or routing the flag experimentally is not a support promise.

surfaces.label: Python output
surfaces.rationale: Python is part of the declared source-target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until Python programs compile and run through the strict target lane.

surfaces.label: HashLink bytecode output
surfaces.rationale: HashLink bytecode is part of the declared VM target matrix.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until real `.hl` output compiles and runs in the strict HashLink lane.

surfaces.label: HashLink C output
surfaces.rationale: The upstream HashLink target lane also generates and executes C output on its supported CI platform.
surfaces.userConsequence: HashLink does not count as Full1-complete unless its required C-output checks pass too.

surfaces.label: Interpreter execution
surfaces.rationale: Interpreter-style execution is a core compiler behavior used by Haxe projects and upstream suites.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until interpreter-style workloads pass without required stage0 delegation.

surfaces.label: Run-module execution
surfaces.rationale: `--run` is a public Haxe execution mode and is used by normal tooling and test orchestration.
surfaces.userConsequence: A Full1 release cannot ship until run-module behavior is covered by same-candidate native evidence.

surfaces.label: XML type-description output
surfaces.rationale: The first Full1 claim does not yet include a compatible XML type-description generator.
surfaces.userConsequence: Builds or tools that require `--xml` must keep using upstream Haxe 4.3.7 for that step.

surfaces.label: JSON type-description output
surfaces.rationale: The first Full1 claim does not yet include a compatible JSON type-description generator.
surfaces.userConsequence: Builds or tools that require `--json` must keep using upstream Haxe 4.3.7 for that step.

nonGoals: An unqualified all-target Haxe 4.3.7 drop-in claim
Direct JVM bytecode, XML type-description, and JSON type-description output in the first Full1 release
